title: Quark-Lepton Color-Flavor Unification
summary: We present an $SU(12) \times SU(2)_L \times U(1)_R$ model unifying $SU(9)$ quark color-flavor with $SU(3)$ lepton flavor as a flavorful alternative to conventional theories of unification. We begin in the ultraviolet with a single yukawa shared by the unified up-type quarks and neutrinos, and no further new fermions. We show that gauged quark color-flavor and lepton flavor instantons dynamically generate the bottom and tau yukawas, which implements a massless quark solution to the strong CP problem and sets up a flavored type-I seesaw mechanism.
